SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner displays teamwork as they contribute to group decisions while playing word games.

• Learning to learn: The learner learns independently as they practise using target letters in forming words and complete the task at the right time.
